title: Smoldering Ember Deposit
description: A wall of dark basalt glows with veins of trapped embers, pulsing faintly like a dying heartbeat. Heat radiates from the stone in waves, and fine ash drifts from cracks where the rock has split. Below the formation, a shallow drift of powdered ash has accumulated over countless eruptions.

choices.label: Mine the ember dust
choices.description: Scrape the glowing veins free and collect the smoldering powder.

outcomes.text: The veins crack apart easily, spilling fine ember dust into your collection pouches. The warmth lingers in your fingers.
You scrape a decent amount of powder free, though the deeper veins are too hot to reach safely.
A vein ruptures as you chip at it, spraying superheated dust across your face. Your eyes sting and skin blisters.

choices.label: Chip out the volcanic glass
choices.description: Pry loose the dark, glassy deposits fused into the basalt.

outcomes.text: Clean fractures split the glass free in usable sheets. A glassblower would pay well for these.
The glass shatters unevenly, but a few good pieces survive. Better than nothing.
A razor-thin shard slices deep into your palm as the formation collapses. Blood hisses on the hot stone.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: The heat is too intense to linger.

outcomes.text: You shield your face from the pulsing heat and press on. The basalt wall continues to glow behind you like an angry wound.
